metadata.methods_description: EEG data were recorded from 19 monopolar channels using the standard 10/20 system referenced to earlobes at 500Hz sampling rate with electrode impedance maintained below 20kOhm. Auditory stimulation consisted of a 5kHz carrier tone amplitude-modulated with a 40Hz rectangular wave (4% duty cycle, 1ms on per 25ms cycle). Visual stimulation was a 20Hz flickering white light produced by an LED array at 50cm distance with 50% duty cycle, designed to drive 40Hz brain oscillations through harmonic frequencies. Preprocessing followed Makoto's pipeline including highpass filtering (>1Hz), line noise removal, bad channel rejection and interpolation, average re-referencing, Artifact Subspace Reconstruction (ASR), re-referencing to average, independent component analysis (ICA) for source separation, dipole fitting, and rejection of bad dipoles. All preprocessing was performed using EEGLab MATLAB toolbox.
